note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by Mr. James L. Clark on 6 May 1936. Twenty-two divisions were filled unopposed; no nominations were received for Ballinadrenta and Connor, whose retiring members held their seats. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Antrim that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
